name: dsdv_gunit_l1
structural_change: S81U-GUNIT-L1 (10-17): L1 (GUNIT2: 114,054 sinks on one root, clock-rule FAIL) is now the router STACK leaf only: rung feedthrough, SC checks / window + job sequencer, per-front control, bias-row writes to the fronts' SRAM macros, ids CTL row from the collector, routing-weight operands (renumbered ids row + one gathered score row) to L3, weight-row merge (~3.9k flops generic). Score store, bias table (now 8 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 in the fronts) and the select (two compare-exchanges per stage) moved to five E-side leaves dsdv_gunit_l1f x4 + dsdv_gunit_l1c. Every input lands in a flop, every output leaves a flop; no ready / credit. | S81U-GUNIT-L1b (10-17): NATIVE-2 pin rules (relayed reset, pin flops) + one-compare-deep select stages ; collector ids into pin flops (+1 edge ids row)

job.purpose: S81-DV G-unit router leaf L1 to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (dsdv_gunit_l* input/output flops, dsdv_gunit_pass feedthroughs, ot_dsdv_vstop's own flops); recipe pin_regs would add an unpriced stage on the router's critical path and on every rung hop.
